```{r, warning=FALSE}
library("terra")
library("sf")
library("dplyr")
library("mgcv")
library("pROC")
```



```{r}
# ===========================
# Spatial logistic (robust) — R/terra + mgcv, custom spatial CV
# + adds CISI + Modification predictors
# ===========================

# ---- 0) Packages ----
#pkgs <- c("terra","sf","dplyr","mgcv","pROC")
#inst <- pkgs[!(pkgs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
#if (length(inst)) install.packages(inst, dependencies = TRUE)
#invisible(lapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE))

# ---- 1) Paths ----
y_dir    <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/1 Forest change 30m"
topo_dir <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/9 elevation and slope 30m"
clim_dir <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/6 CHELSA mean 1 km 30m"
pop_dir  <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/7 Population mean 100m 30m"
dist_dir <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/distances_30m_aligned"
mod_dir  <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/6  Modification 30m"
light_dir <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/7 Night light 30m"
dist_road <- "C:/Users/oleks/Desktop/DEFORESTATION/2 Logistic regression/3 HARMONIZED DATA/10 road"






# ---- 2) Tunables ----
canopy_threshold <- 30
loss_year_min <- 1
loss_year_max <- 20
n_per_class   <- 2000
block_range_m <- 3000
k_folds       <- 5
set.seed(42)




# ---- 3) Helpers ----
sanitize_names <- function(files) {
  nm <- tolower(basename(files))
  nm <- sub("\\.tif(f)?$", "", nm)
  gsub("[^a-z0-9]+","_", nm)
}

stack_from_dir <- function(dir, prefix = NULL) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern="\\.tif(f)?$", full.names=TRUE, ignore.case=TRUE)
  cat("\nFiles in", dir, ":\n")
  print(files)

  if (!length(files)) return(NULL)

  r <- rast(files)
  nm <- sanitize_names(files)
  if (!is.null(prefix)) nm <- paste0(prefix, "_", nm)
  names(r) <- make.unique(nm)
  r
}

align_to <- function(r, ref, method="bilinear") {
  if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
  if (!same.crs(r, ref)) r <- project(r, crs(ref))
  resample(r, ref, method=method)
}

to_utm_crs <- function(xy_sf) {
  ctr <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(xy_sf))))
  lon <- ctr[1]; lat <- ctr[2]
  zone <- floor((lon + 180)/6) + 1
  epsg <- if (lat >= 0) 32600 + zone else 32700 + zone
  st_transform(xy_sf, paste0("EPSG:", epsg))
}




# helper to combine only non-NULL rasters
c_nonnull <- function(...) {
  lst <- list(...)
  lst <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lst)
  if (!length(lst)) return(NULL)
  do.call(c, lst)
}




# ---- 4) Response (Y) from Hansen ----
lossyear <- rast(file.path(y_dir, "Hansen_GFC-2024-v1.12_lossyear_50N_020E.tif"))
tree2000 <- rast(file.path(y_dir, "Hansen_GFC-2024-v1.12_treecover2000_50N_020E.tif"))
datamask <- rast(file.path(y_dir, "Hansen_GFC-2024-v1.12_datamask_50N_020E.tif"))

forest2000 <- (tree2000 > canopy_threshold) & (datamask == 1)

y_bin <- app(lossyear, fun = function(v) as.integer(v >= loss_year_min & v <= loss_year_max))
y_bin <- mask(y_bin, forest2000)

# ---- 5) Predictors: load, align, combine, drop zero-variance ----
X_topo <- align_to(stack_from_dir(topo_dir, "topo"), y_bin, method="bilinear")
X_clim <- align_to(stack_from_dir(clim_dir, "clim"), y_bin, method="bilinear")
X_pop  <- align_to(stack_from_dir(pop_dir,  "pop"),  y_bin, method="bilinear")
X_dist <- align_to(stack_from_dir(dist_dir, "dist"), y_bin, method="bilinear")
X_light <- align_to(stack_from_dir(light_dir, "light"), y_bin, method="bilinear")
X_road <- align_to(stack_from_dir(dist_road, "road"), y_bin, method="bilinear")
X_mod  <- align_to(stack_from_dir(mod_dir,  "mod"),  y_bin, method="bilinear")



preds <- c_nonnull(X_topo, X_clim, X_pop, X_dist, X_mod, X_light, X_road)
if (is.null(preds)) stop("No predictor rasters were found. Check your directories.")





# Drop layers that are all NA or constant (using global range)
gr <- terra::global(preds, fun="range", na.rm=TRUE)
if (is.null(gr)) stop("Predictors have no valid range; check alignment/coverage.")

gr_df <- as.data.frame(gr)
keep <- with(gr_df, is.finite(min) & is.finite(max) & (max - min) > 0)

if (!any(keep)) stop("All predictors appear constant or invalid after alignment.")
preds <- preds[[which(keep)]]

cat("\nPredictor layers kept:\n")
print(names(preds))






# ---- 6) Stratified sample of pixels (within forest mask) ----
vals <- values(y_bin, mat=FALSE)

pos_cells <- which(vals == 1)
neg_cells <- which(vals == 0)

if (!length(pos_cells)) stop("No positive (loss) pixels found in the specified year range.")
if (!length(neg_cells)) stop("No negative (no-loss) pixels found in mask.")

i_pos <- sample(pos_cells, min(length(pos_cells), n_per_class))
i_neg <- sample(neg_cells, min(length(neg_cells), n_per_class))
cells <- c(i_pos, i_neg)

xy  <- xyFromCell(y_bin, cells)
pts <- vect(data.frame(x=xy[,1], y=xy[,2]), geom=c("x","y"), crs=crs(y_bin))

Xdat <- terra::extract(preds, pts, ID=FALSE)

dat <- cbind(
  y      = as.integer(vals[cells]),
  as.data.frame(Xdat),
  xcoord = xy[,1],
  ycoord = xy[,2]
)

dat <- na.omit(dat)
cat("\nTraining rows after NA removal:", nrow(dat), "\n")
if (length(unique(dat$y)) < 2) stop("Only one class present after NA removal; lower canopy threshold or increase sample size.")






# ---- 7) Build spatial blocks (custom, no blockCV) ----
pts_sf  <- st_as_sf(dat, coords=c("xcoord","ycoord"), crs=crs(y_bin))
pts_utm <- to_utm_crs(pts_sf)
utm_xy  <- st_coordinates(pts_utm)

gx <- floor((utm_xy[,1] - min(utm_xy[,1])) / block_range_m)
gy <- floor((utm_xy[,2] - min(utm_xy[,2])) / block_range_m)
block_id <- interaction(gx, gy, drop=TRUE)

set.seed(42)
uniq_blocks <- levels(block_id)
fold_map <- setNames(sample(rep(1:k_folds, length.out=length(uniq_blocks))), uniq_blocks)
dat$fold <- fold_map[as.character(block_id)]


# If any fold has a weak TRAIN set, reassign it into a good fold
fold_ok <- rep(TRUE, k_folds)
for (i in 1:k_folds) {
  tr <- which(dat$fold != i)
  if (length(tr) < 200 || length(unique(dat$y[tr])) < 2) fold_ok[i] <- FALSE
}
if (!all(fold_ok)) {
  bad <- which(!fold_ok)
  cat("\nFolds with insufficient training diversity:", bad, "\n")
  good <- which(fold_ok)
  for (b in bad) dat$fold[dat$fold == b] <- sample(good, 1)
}






# ---- 8) GAM formula(s) and spatial CV ----
pred_names <- setdiff(names(dat), c("y","fold","xcoord","ycoord"))

smooth_terms <- paste0("s(", pred_names, ", k=5)")
form_spatial   <- as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(c(smooth_terms, "s(xcoord, ycoord, k=70)"), collapse=" + ")))
form_nospatial <- as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(smooth_terms, collapse=" + ")))

cv_auc <- rep(NA_real_, k_folds)

for (i in 1:k_folds) {
  te <- which(dat$fold == i)
  tr <- which(dat$fold != i)

  # guards
  if (length(tr) < 200 || length(unique(dat$y[tr])) < 2) next
  if (length(unique(dat$y[te])) < 2) {
    cat(sprintf("Fold %d: test set has only one class -> AUC=NA\n", i))
    next
  }

  fit_i <- mgcv::gam(form_spatial, data=dat[tr,], family=binomial(), method="REML")

  p_i <- predict(fit_i, newdata=dat[te,], type="response")
  cv_auc[i] <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(response = dat$y[te], predictor = p_i))

  cat(sprintf("Fold %d: train=%d, test=%d, AUC=%.3f\n", i, length(tr), length(te), cv_auc[i]))
}

cat(sprintf("\nMean spatial CV AUC: %.3f (sd=%.3f)\n",
            mean(cv_auc, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd(cv_auc, na.rm=TRUE)))





# ---- 9) Fit final model (NO spatial smooth) ----
fit <- mgcv::gam(
  form_nospatial,
  data   = dat,
  family = binomial(),
  method = "REML",
  select = TRUE,
  gamma  = 1.2
)

print(summary(fit))
```

fit <- mgcv::gam(
  y ~
    s(elevation_30m,             k = 10) +
    s(slope_deg_30m,             k = 10) +
    s(pr_mean_2000_2020,         k = 20) +  # ↑
    s(tasmax_mean_2000_2020,     k = 20) +  # ↑
    s(tasmin_mean_2000_2020,     k = 20) +  # ↑
    s(vpd_mean_2000_2020,        k = 20) +  # ↑
    s(population_mean_2000_2020, k = 10) +
    s(dist_agricultural_areas,   k = 10) +
    s(dist_artificial_surfaces,  k = 15) +  # small bump
    s(dist_water_bodies,         k = 15) +  # ↑
    s(xcoord, ycoord,            k = 150),  # ↑ spatial
  data   = dat,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  method = "REML",
  select = TRUE,
  gamma  = 1.2
)


print(summary(fit))

```{r}
## 1. Get deviance residuals from your GAM
res_dev <- residuals(fit, type = "deviance")  # or type = "pearson"

## 2. Set up plotting area: 1 row, 2 columns
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2))  # save old par to restore later

## 3. Histogram of deviance residuals
hist(
  res_dev,
  breaks = 40,                 # adjust if you want more/less detail
  main   = "Deviance residuals",
  xlab   = "Residual",
  freq   = FALSE                # show density, not counts
)
lines(density(res_dev), lwd = 2)

## 4. QQ-plot of deviance residuals vs Normal
qqnorm(
  res_dev,
  main = "QQ-plot of deviance residuals"
)
qqline(res_dev, col = 2, lwd = 2)

## 5. Restore old plotting parameters
par(op)
```





```{r}
res_dev <- residuals(fit, type = "deviance")

# y is a column in dat
res0 <- res_dev[dat$y == 0]
res1 <- res_dev[dat$y == 1]

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(res0, breaks = 40, main = "Deviance residuals (y = 0)", xlab = "Residual")
hist(res1, breaks = 40, main = "Deviance residuals (y = 1)", xlab = "Residual")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```




```{r}
res_dev <- residuals(fit, type = "deviance")
fit_prob <- fitted(fit)  # or predict(fit, type = "response")

plot(fit_prob, res_dev,
     xlab = "Fitted probability",
     ylab = "Deviance residual",
     main = "Residuals vs fitted")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
```

```{r}
# Pearson residuals (better for correlation tests)
dat$res_pearson <- residuals(fit2, type = "pearson")


# install.packages("ggplot2")  # if needed
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = xcoord, y = ycoord, colour = res_pearson)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.6) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_colour_gradient2(
    name = "Pearson\nresidual",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial pattern of Pearson residuals",
    x = "xcoord", y = "ycoord"
  )

```




```{r}

library(spdep)

coords <- cbind(dat$xcoord, dat$ycoord)

# 8-nearest neighbours
knn   <- knearneigh(coords, k = 8)
nb    <- knn2nb(knn)
lw    <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")  # row-standardised weights

# Moran's I test
moran.test(dat$res_pearson, lw)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
moran.mc(dat$res_pearson, lw, nsim = 199)
```




```{r}
# install.packages(c("sp", "gstat"))  # if needed
library(sp)
library(gstat)

# make a SpatialPointsDataFrame copy so we don't touch original dat
dat_sp <- dat
coordinates(dat_sp) <- ~ xcoord + ycoord

# empirical variogram of residuals
vg_res <- variogram(res_pearson ~ 1, dat_sp)  # ~1 = no trend
plot(vg_res, main = "Empirical variogram of Pearson residuals")
```
